scenario: The ego vehicle merges from a highway on-ramp into the main highway traffic while two other vehicles travel ahead in the main lanes.

ego.behavior: The car accelerates along the on-ramp and merges into the rightmost lane of the main highway.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight ahead in the rightmost lane of the main highway, maintaining a consistent speed.
The car travels straight ahead in the middle lane of the main highway, parallel to the other adversarial car.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on a curved on-ramp that merges into a multi-lane highway from the right, while two adversarial cars are positioned ahead in the main highway lanes; the on-ramp joins the highway at an acute angle.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must merge from the on-ramp into the main highway traffic without collision; initial spacing is defined between the ego and the two adversarial vehicles ahead in the main lanes; the scenario terminates once the ego successfully completes the merge.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The green car is ego (distinctive color, on-ramp position); two orange cars are adversarials in main lanes. 2. Chronology: Initially ego is behind on on-ramp, adversarials ahead on highway. Midpoint ego accelerates along ramp toward merge point. Ending ego completes merge into right lane behind first adversarial. 3. Evidence: ego's path curves from ramp to align with highway; lateral position shifts from separate road to right lane; adversarials maintain straight trajectories in main lanes throughout.
